```{r import}
library(tidyverse)
library(broom)
library(parameters)
library(knitr)
library(interactions)
library(effectsize)
DATA_DIR <- "/Users/mlin2/Desktop/RabLab/tasks/concurrent/data/cleaned_dat/"
RESULT_DIR <-"/Users/mlin2/Desktop/RabLab/tasks/concurrent/data/result_table/"
mergedat <- read_csv(file.path(DATA_DIR, "merged_baseline_wDemo.csv"))
mergedat <- mergedat %>%
  mutate(log_ptau217 = log(ptau217)) %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(ptau217),
    !is.na(desikan_suvr),
    !is.na(centiloid_wcbl)
  )

df_base_eoad <- mergedat %>% filter(dx == "EOAD")
df_base_ci   <- mergedat %>% filter(dx %in% c("EOAD", "EOnonAD"))
covars <- c("age_at_ptau", "sex", "years_education")
mergedat %>% count(dx)
```

```{r helper for extracting terms}
extract_term_stats <- function(fit, term_name) {
  raw_tbl <- broom::tidy(fit, conf.int = TRUE) %>%
    filter(term == term_name)

  std_tbl <- parameters::standardize_parameters(fit, method = "posthoc") %>%
    as_tibble() %>%
    rename(term = Parameter) %>%
    filter(term == term_name)

  if (nrow(raw_tbl) == 0 || nrow(std_tbl) == 0) {
    return(tibble(
      b = NA_real_, b_low = NA_real_, b_high = NA_real_, p = NA_real_,
      beta = NA_real_, beta_low = NA_real_, beta_high = NA_real_
    ))
  }

  tibble(
    b = raw_tbl$estimate,
    b_low = raw_tbl$conf.low,
    b_high = raw_tbl$conf.high,
    p = raw_tbl$p.value,
    beta = std_tbl$Std_Coefficient,
    beta_low = std_tbl$CI_low,
    beta_high = std_tbl$CI_high
  )
}

```

```{r helper function for reporting}
summarize_model_row <- function(fit, model_name, term_map, covars = character(0)) {
  
  tidy_tbl <- broom::tidy(fit, conf.int = TRUE)

  out <- tibble(
    model = model_name,
    formula = paste(deparse(formula(fit)), collapse = ""),
    n = nobs(fit),
    r2 = summary(fit)$r.squared,
    adj_r2 = summary(fit)$adj.r.squared
  )

  # --- main terms (existing logic) ---
  for (term_name in names(term_map)) {
    prefix <- term_map[[term_name]]
    stats <- extract_term_stats(fit, term_name)

    out[[paste0(prefix, "_b")]]        <- stats$b
    out[[paste0(prefix, "_b_low")]]    <- stats$b_low
    out[[paste0(prefix, "_b_high")]]   <- stats$b_high
    out[[paste0(prefix, "_p")]]        <- stats$p
    out[[paste0(prefix, "_beta")]]     <- stats$beta
    out[[paste0(prefix, "_beta_low")]] <- stats$beta_low
    out[[paste0(prefix, "_beta_high")]]<- stats$beta_high
  }

  # --- covariates ---
  if (length(covars) > 0) {
    sig_covars <- tidy_tbl %>%
      filter(term %in% covars, p.value < 0.05) %>%
      mutate(
        label = paste0(term, " (p=", sprintf("%.3f", p.value), ")")
      ) %>%
      pull(label)

    out$significant_covariates <- if (length(sig_covars) > 0) {
      paste(sig_covars, collapse = "; ")
    } else {
      NA_character_
    }
  } else {
    out$significant_covariates <- NA_character_
  }

  out
}

make_formula <- function(outcome, rhs, covars = character(0)) {
  f <- paste(outcome, "~", rhs)
  if (length(covars) > 0) {
    f <- paste0(f, " + ", paste(covars, collapse = " + "))
  }
  as.formula(f)
}

fit_model_block <- function(df, cohort_name, outcome, covars = character(0)) {
  needed <- unique(c(outcome, "centiloid_wcbl", "desikan_suvr", covars))
  miss <- setdiff(needed, names(df))
  if (length(miss) > 0) stop("Missing columns in ", cohort_name, ": ", paste(miss, collapse = ", "))

  dd <- df %>% drop_na(all_of(needed))

  m1_cl     <- lm(make_formula(outcome, "centiloid_wcbl", covars), data = dd)
  m2_tau    <- lm(make_formula(outcome, "desikan_suvr", covars), data = dd)
  m3_cl_tau <- lm(make_formula(outcome, "centiloid_wcbl + desikan_suvr", covars), data = dd)
  m4_inter  <- lm(make_formula(outcome, "centiloid_wcbl * desikan_suvr", covars), data = dd)

  term_map <- c(
    centiloid_wcbl = "CL",
    desikan_suvr = "TAU",
    `centiloid_wcbl:desikan_suvr` = "CLxTAU"
  )

  bind_rows(
    summarize_model_row(m1_cl,     "pTau ~ CL",       term_map,covars),
    summarize_model_row(m2_tau,    "pTau ~ TAU",      term_map,covars),
    summarize_model_row(m3_cl_tau, "pTau ~ CL + TAU",  term_map,covars),
    summarize_model_row(m4_inter,  "pTau ~ CL * TAU",  term_map,covars)
  ) %>%
    mutate(
      cohort = cohort_name,
      outcome = outcome,
      adjusted = if_else(length(covars) > 0, "adjusted", "unadjusted"),
      covariates = if_else(length(covars) > 0,
                           paste(covars, collapse = " + "),
                           "none")
    ) %>%
    dplyr::select(cohort, outcome, adjusted, covariates, everything())
}
```

``` {r modeling}
outcomes <- c("log_ptau217", "ptau217")
cohorts <- list(
  df_base_ci = df_base_ci,
  df_base_eoad = df_base_eoad
)

covar_sets <- list(
  unadjusted = character(0),
  adjusted = covars
)

all_results <- purrr::map_dfr(names(cohorts), function(cohort_name) {
  df <- cohorts[[cohort_name]]

  purrr::map_dfr(outcomes, function(outcome) {
    purrr::map_dfr(names(covar_sets), function(adj_name) {

      fit_model_block(
        df,
        cohort_name,
        outcome,
        covar_sets[[adj_name]]
      )

    })
  })
})

all_results_round <- all_results %>%
  mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~ round(.x, 3)))

all_results_round
```

```{r compact result table}
fmt_term <- function(b, low, high, p, digits = 3) { 
  if (any(is.na(c(b, low, high, p)))) 
    return(NA_character_) 
  sprintf( paste0("%.", digits, "f [%.", digits, "f, %.", digits, "f], p=%.", digits, "f"), b, low, high, p ) 
  }

result_vis <- all_results_round %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(
    model = paste0(
      cohort, " | ",
      case_when(
        model == "pTau ~ CL" ~ "CL",
        model == "pTau ~ TAU" ~ "TAU",
        model == "pTau ~ CL + TAU" ~ "CL + TAU",
        model == "pTau ~ CL * TAU" ~ "CL * TAU",
        TRUE ~ model
      ),
      " | ",
      if_else(outcome == "log_ptau217", "log(ptau)", "ptau"),
      if_else(adjusted == "adjusted", " +covar", "")
    ),

    CL = fmt_term(CL_b, CL_b_low, CL_b_high, CL_p),
    TAU = fmt_term(TAU_b, TAU_b_low, TAU_b_high, TAU_p),
    Interaction = fmt_term(CLxTAU_b, CLxTAU_b_low, CLxTAU_b_high, CLxTAU_p),

    `Significant covariates` = significant_covariates,
    `Adjusted R^2` = adj_r2
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  dplyr::select(model, CL, TAU, Interaction, `Significant covariates`, `Adjusted R^2`)
readr::write_csv( result_vis,file =file.path(RESULT_DIR, "ptau_pet_model_summary_wCov.csv"))
result_vis
```

``` {r interaction-helper}
make_interaction_plot <- function(fit, pred, modx, title, xlab, ylab,
                                 low_col, high_col, ylim = c(-3,3)) {

  p <- interact_plot(
    fit,
    pred = {{ pred }},
    modx = {{ modx }},
    modx.values = "terciles",
    plot.points = TRUE,
    interval = TRUE
  ) +
    scale_color_gradient(low = low_col, high = high_col) +
    scale_fill_gradient(low = low_col, high = high_col) +
    guides(fill = "none") +   
    labs(title = title, x = xlab, y = ylab) +
    theme_classic()

  # enforce y axis
  p$scales$scales <- p$scales$scales[
    !sapply(p$scales$scales, function(s) "y" %in% s$aesthetics)
  ]

  p + scale_y_continuous(limits = ylim)
}
```

```{r marginal r helper} 

extract_marginal_r2 <- function(fit, terms) {
  rel <- calc.relimp(fit, type = "lmg", rela = TRUE)

  out <- rel$lmg
  out <- out[names(out) %in% terms]

  as_tibble(as.list(out))
}
```

```{r fit ~biomarker model}
fit_biomarker_models <- function(df, cohort_name, outcome, covars = character(0)) {

  predictors_list <- list(
    ptau = "ptau217",
    log_ptau = "log_ptau217",
    cl = "centiloid_wcbl",
    tau = "desikan_suvr",
    full_ptau = "ptau217 + centiloid_wcbl + desikan_suvr",
    full_logptau = "log_ptau217 + centiloid_wcbl + desikan_suvr"
  )

  results <- purrr::map_dfr(names(predictors_list), function(name) {

    rhs <- predictors_list[[name]]

    fit <- lm(make_formula(outcome, rhs, covars), data = df)

    base <- tibble(
      model = name,
      formula = paste(deparse(formula(fit)), collapse = ""),
      n = nobs(fit),
      r2 = summary(fit)$r.squared,
      adj_r2 = summary(fit)$adj.r.squared
    )

    # --- coefficients ---
    tidy_tbl <- broom::tidy(fit, conf.int = TRUE)

    coef_tbl <- tidy_tbl %>%
      filter(term != "(Intercept)") %>%
      mutate(
        term_label = paste0(
          term, ": ",
          sprintf("%.3f [%.3f, %.3f], p=%.3f",
                  estimate, conf.low, conf.high, p.value)
        )
      ) %>%
      summarise(coefs = paste(term_label, collapse = "; "))

    eta_tbl <- effectsize::eta_squared(fit, partial = TRUE) %>%
    as_tibble()

    # find the correct eta column automatically
    eta_col <- grep("^Eta2", names(eta_tbl), value = TRUE)
    
    rel_str <- eta_tbl %>%
      filter(Parameter != "(Intercept)") %>%
      mutate(
        label = paste0(Parameter, " ", sprintf("%.3f", .data[[eta_col]]))
      ) %>%
      pull(label)
    
    rel_str <- if (length(rel_str) > 0) {
      paste(rel_str, collapse = "; ")
    } else {
      NA_character_
    }
     
    base %>%
      bind_cols(coef_tbl) %>%
      mutate(
        partial_r2 = rel_str,
        cohort = cohort_name,
        outcome = outcome,
        adjusted = if_else(length(covars) > 0, "adjusted", "unadjusted")
      )

  })

  results
}
```
